Citizen Housing Group Trading Update and Credit Opinion Update
Trading Update for the Period Ending 30 September 2026
Citizen Treasury plc announces the Citizen Housing Group consolidated unaudited trading update for the six months ending 30 September 2026. The report can be accessed here.

This trading update contains certain forward-looking statements about the outlook for the Group. Although the directors believe that these statements are based upon reasonable assumptions, any such statements should be treated with caution as the outlook may be influenced by factors that could cause actual outcomes and results to be materially different.
Updated Investor Presentation
An updated investor presentation has been released on our website and can be accessed here.
Credit Opinion Update from Moody's Investors Service at 6 November 2026

Citizen Treasury plc announces that Moody’s have published an updated credit opinion for Citizen Housing Group maintaining our A3 stable rating. The credit opinion reflects the high proportion of turnover coming from social housing lettings and improving operating performance. The credit opinion published by Moody’s can be accessed here.
This announcement has been made by Gary Booth, Chief Financial Officer, on behalf of Citizen Treasury plc.
